newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady but dependent on arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady but dependent on arbitrage.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to firmer in quiet trade on Friday, traders said.
They expected price direction to continue to depend on arbitrage activity with European demand staying thin and refiner stocks creeping higher as a result.
Most prompt cargo avails were cleared up this week but the barge market will continue to look for transatlantic arbitrage to balance the dearth of demand from European inland markets traders said.
However, expensive shipping costs with freight space tight, may continue to limit arbitrage options.
Prices could therefore resume the down trend of earlier this week that saw them tumble around $16 a tonne at one point.
"We chased the U.S. market lower in its recent falls, so in theory the arbitrage has always been open, but higher freight costs have restricted arbitrage options," a trader at a U.K. major said.
Eurograde barges valued around $210 a tonne fob ARA with cargoes valued $214.50 cif NWE.
